nodes.label: piSignage Arbitrary File Download via Path Traversal (api/settings/log)
nodes.precondition: Attacker possesses authenticated low-privilege access to piSignage player API (versions prior to 2.6.4) hosted on a Raspberry Pi device.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker downloads arbitrary system and configuration files (e.g., /etc/shadow, application secrets, credentials) from the underlying Raspberry Pi operating system.

nodes.label: RaspAP Unrestricted Web Console Remote Command Execution (includes/webconsole.php)
nodes.precondition: Attacker possesses authenticated access to the RaspAP 2.5 web interface running on the Raspberry Pi.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker executes arbitrary OS commands, uploads malicious payloads, and executes code with web server user privileges on the underlying Raspberry Pi OS.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi OS Default 'pi:raspberry' Credential Exploitation
nodes.precondition: Network or local terminal access to Raspberry Pi OS (versions through 5.10) where the default password 'raspberry' for the 'pi' user account remains unchanged.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker acquires administrative and full root privileges (via sudo) on the Raspberry Pi operating system.

nodes.label: Glowworm Optical Side-Channel Acoustic Recovery Attack
nodes.precondition: Target Raspberry Pi (3 B+ or 4 B through 2021-08-09) supplies power directly to connected audio speakers playing sound; optical line-of-sight to the power indicator LED exists with an electro-optical sensor and telescope.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker remotely reconstructs and eavesdrops on speech and acoustic signals output by speakers through optical fluctuations in power LED intensity.

nodes.label: Oculus Browser Remote HTML Injection and UI Spoofing
nodes.precondition: Target user visits a malicious remote web page using Oculus Browser (versions 5.2.7 through 5.7.11).
nodes.postcondition: Attacker spoofs browser UI elements and achieves unprivileged local code execution within the Oculus Browser process context.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRRedir.exe Hard Link Arbitrary File Write Privilege Escalation
nodes.precondition: Attacker has local unprivileged code execution on a Windows host running Oculus Desktop before 1.44.0.32849 with a privileged OVRRedir.exe process.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker writes to arbitrary system files via hard-linked log files, escalating privileges to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRServiceLauncher.exe Privileged Process Handle Leak
nodes.precondition: Attacker has local unprivileged process execution on a Windows host running Oculus Desktop (versions after 1.39 and prior to 31.1.0.67.507) with OVRServiceLauncher.exe.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker acquires a leaked privileged process handle, leading to local privilege escalation to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Jetson Linux IOMMU Configuration Error PCI Address Space Bypass
nodes.precondition: Unprivileged attacker possesses physical access to the NVIDIA Jetson Linux board and the PCI bus interface with a misconfigured IOMMU.
nodes.postcondition: Attacker achieves direct read/write access across the complete system address space, causing denial of service, full kernel/root compromise, memory tampering, and breach of connected components.
